Vaga: Engenheiro DevOps Sênior (Infraestrutura, Banco de Dados e Escalabilidade)


Localização: Remoto ou Escritório (Novo Hamburgo - RS)


Sobre nós:


A DKW System é uma empresa inovadora no setor de tecnologia de CRM, omni-channel, inteligência artificial e marketing, que trabalha com uma stack moderna e escalável, voltada para ambientes de alta performance e infraestrutura resiliente. Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro DevOps Pleno/Sênior para gerenciar nossa infraestrutura, bancos de dados e processos de escalabilidade, sempre focando na alta disponibilidade, segurança e performance.



O que você vai fazer:


•⁠ ⁠Gerenciar e otimizar a infraestrutura: Administra servidores, incluindo Linux, Node.js, Redis, RabbitMQ, Nginx, e PostgreSQL.

•⁠ ⁠Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade: Configurar e implementar soluções de escalabilidade (auto-scaling, balanceamento de carga, failover) em ambientes em nuvem.

•⁠ ⁠Banco de Dados: Tunar e otimizar o banco PostgreSQL para garantir performance, integridade e segurança. Gerenciar backups e replicação.

•⁠ ⁠Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e configurar ferramentas de monitoramento como Zabbix, New Relic, para garantir alta performance e disponibilidade dos serviços.

•⁠ ⁠Automação e Infraestrutura como Código: Automatizar deploys, pipelines e provisionamento de infraestrutura usando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible, PM2.

•⁠ ⁠Redes e Segurança: Garantir que a rede e a infraestrutura sejam seguras, com conhecimento profundo de redes (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs, etc.) e otimização de tráfego.

•⁠ ⁠Suporte e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e corrigir problemas de infraestrutura e banco de dados, garantindo que as aplicações estejam sempre disponíveis e escaláveis.


O que esperamos de você:


•⁠ ⁠Experiência sólida em DevOps: 3+ anos de experiência em ambientes de produção com servidores, infraestruturas e soluções em nuvem (AWS, GCP, etc).

•⁠⁠ Domínio em Banco de Dados PostgreSQL: Experiência prática com tuning de performance, backup, replicação e clusters.

•⁠ ⁠Conhecimento em ferramentas de fila de mensagens: Experiência com Redis e RabbitMQ.

•⁠ ⁠Experiência com servidores e redes: Experiência com Nginx, balanceamento de carga, alta disponibilidade, configuração de servidores e conhecimento em redes TCP/IP.

•⁠ Automação e Monitoramento: Experiência com ferramentas como Zabbix, New Relic, PM2, Terraform, e Ansible.

•⁠ ⁠Experiência em Cloud e escalabilidade: Conhecimento em provedores de nuvem, containers, auto-scaling e infraestrutura resiliente.


Diferenciais:


•⁠ ⁠Experiência com Kubernetes e containers.

•⁠ ⁠Certificações em AWS, GCP, Azure ou áreas correlatas.

•⁠ ⁠Experiência com CI/CD e Infraestrutura como código.



Por que trabalhar com a gente?


•⁠ ⁠Ambiente dinâmico e inovador com um time ágil e altamente colaborativo.

•⁠ Crescimento profissional : Ajudamos no desenvolvimento contínuo de suas habilidades e promovemos oportunidades de aprendizado.

Localidades:

  • Unidade Andrade | Pitangueiras/SP


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Strategy and Planning Expert
description:
What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Model Evolution : Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management : Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.
  • Strategic Planning : Develop and lead the strategic planning process for the vertical, identifying market trends, competitive threats, and growth opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable, measurable plans.
  • PMO for Implementation : Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement : Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management : Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.


What We Need From You

  • Education : Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience : Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen : Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills : Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management : Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design : Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership : A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

title: Domain Architect Networking
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo.


In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi-Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting multicultural and multifunctional environment.


Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission-critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.
  • Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.
  • Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.
  • Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.
  • Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.
  • Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.
  • Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.
  • Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.
  • Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.
  • Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.
  • Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.
  • Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.
  • Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).
  • Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi-platform integration and international performance with remote teams.
  • Fluent English (essential), advanced Portuguese as a differential for Brazil-Canada integration.


Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence, consultative action and consensus building between teams and global cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical ability to plan, execute, and evolve complex, highly available architectures.
  • Clear and assertive communication with stakeholders at all levels, internationally distributed teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, focus on solutions, adaptability and collaborative posture.
  • Absolute focus on results – operational, safety, innovation and support of infrastructure.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações: CCNP/CCIE, AWS/Azure/GCP Advanced Networking, CISSP, VMware NSX, ITIL Expert, TOGAF.
  • Experience in greenfield/brownfield projects, integration of industrial networks/IoT, edge/mesh/satellite, mine digitalization.
  • Experience with underground networks, mining-specific wireless solutions, industrial OT/IT environments, SRE/observability on a global scale.
  • Participation in technical forums, publications, international events, benchmarks, leadership in strategic projects from or large mining companies.
  • Ability to work in different time zones, multi-site environments and multicultural teams.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust and secure reference architecture for all Brazil and Canada network environments, including integration, automation, performance and high availability.
  • Execution of strategic projects for technological evolution, digitalization, automation, analytics and ESG, supporting business results.
  • Dissemination of best practices, technical painting of the teams involved, development of governance policies and global operation.
  • Active performance in innovation, benchmarking and implementation of new technologies that support the group's digital and operational transformation.
  • Ensuring compliance, operational resilience, risk mitigation and increasing efficiency for operations.


Additional Comments:

This professional will be a protagonist in the transformation and support of corporate, industrial and critical network architecture, enabling the global Brazil-Canada operation and the group's digital/ESG evolution.

title: Operations Manager
description:
As we prepare to launch our licensed operations in Brazil, we’re seeking a strategic yet hands-on Operations Manager to establish and lead all operational functions on the ground in São Paulo.

Leveraging Ant International’s core platforms for payments, compliance, reporting, and risk, your critical role is to operationalize these global capabilities in the Brazilian context: defining local workflows, adapting procedures to meet BACEN expectations across EMI, payments, and lending (SCD), managing internal partners, and ensuring flawless execution from day one.

With a lean local team and key functions still centralized, you’ll wear multiple hats: acting as builder, executor, regulator liaison as needed, and team leader—while contributing directly to how global practices evolve to serve Brazil’s unique market.


Key Responsibilities:


1. Local Operational Design & Regulatory Alignment

  • Lead the design and implementation of Brazil-specific operational frameworks across two license types: Payment Institution (EMI and PISP) and SCD (lending)—ensuring full alignment with current and upcoming BACEN requirements;
  • Translate regulatory expectations into actionable operational controls, feeding insights back to global teams to refine shared standards;
  • Define end-to-end procedures for payment processing (PIX, TED/DOC), loan disbursement (for SCD), reconciliation, and incident management—mapped to Ant’s global infrastructure;
  • Support Compliance and Business teams on operational matters during licensing reviews, audits, and ongoing supervision.


2. Cross-Border Execution & Global Integration

  • Partner closely with Ant International’s headquarters in China, working with product, risk, compliance, and engineering teams to ensure Brazil’s operational needs are reflected in global systems and policies;
  • Validate that data flows, reporting logic, and control mechanisms support accurate, timely submissions to Brazilian authorities (e.g., SISBACEN, periodic EMI/SCD reports, RFB, Sisbajud/CNJ, Simba, STA, local authorities in general, etc.);
  • Identify gaps between global processes and local regulatory or market realities—and drive pragmatic, compliant adaptations without compromising system integrity.


3. Hands-On Operational Leadership

  • In this foundational phase, personally execute critical tasks: validate regulatory reports, investigate transaction failures, reconcile settlement accounts, and test live workflows;
  • Manage relationships with local banks, payment scheme participants (e.g., PIX connectors), credit bureaus, and third-party vendors—ensuring seamless integration with Ant’s ecosystem;
  • Build and mentor the first wave of local operations talent as the team scales, instilling a culture of compliance, precision, and customer trust.


4. Risk, Controls & Scalability

  • Implement robust operational risk frameworks tailored to Brazil’s multi-product environment (payments + lending), leveraging Ant Group’s global standards while addressing local threats;
  • Maintain a dynamic risk register, lead incident reviews, and ensure all operational activities support BACEN’s fit-and-proper, capital adequacy, and consumer protection expectations;
  • Design scalable processes that can grow with volume—by optimizing configurations, automation, and human oversight within the existing global structure.


Who You Are:


Deep Expertise in Brazil’s Regulated Financial Landscape

  • 7+ years in operations, compliance, or risk within Brazilian banking, fintech, or financial services;
  • Essential: Direct experience with BACEN-regulated entities, particularly EMIs, Payment Institutions, or SCDs—including licensing processes, ongoing reporting, AML/KYC, reserve rules, and consumer credit regulations;
  • Basic knowledge of development/programming languages, APIs, and XML files is a plus;
  • Fluency in Portuguese (native or fluent) and English (professional proficiency/advanced). Chinese is a plus, not mandatory. Must be based in São Paulo.


Builder Mindset with Global Awareness

  • Proven ability to launch or scale operations in early-stage, regulated environments—you’ve operated where structure meets scrappiness;
  • Experience collaborating with international or offshore teams; you know how to influence without authority and translate local needs into global action, with a resilient and problem-solving-oriented approach;
  • Understand that excellence lies not in rebuilding systems, but in making world-class infrastructure work and adapt itself flawlessly in Brazil.


Operational Rigor & Accountability

  • Obsessive about accuracy, audit readiness, and regulatory detail—but also pragmatic and solution-oriented;
  • Equally comfortable presenting to regulators and debugging a reconciliation file at midnight;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CRC, CEA) are valued but not required.

title: Analista de QA
description:
A Groove Tech está buscando um(a) QA Pleno para atuar com testes manuais e automatizados em aplicações Web e Mobile, garantindo qualidade, eficiência e evolução contínua dos processos de QA.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejamento e Execução: Planejar, elaborar e executar casos de teste manuais e automatizados para backend e frontend.
  • Estratégia de Testes: Aplicar a Pirâmide de Testes e práticas de Shift-Left Testing , promovendo qualidade desde as fases iniciais.
  • Gestão de Defeitos: Registrar, documentar e acompanhar defeitos, garantindo suas correções e realizando retestes completos.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Contribuir para o aprimoramento dos processos de QA e colaborar com equipes multifuncionais.
  • Análise de Dados: Executar consultas SQL para validação de dados e sustentação de cenários complexos.
  • Técnicas Avançadas: Aplicar técnicas como Partição de Equivalência, Valor Limite, Tabela de Decisão, Status Value, entre outras.
  • Monitoramento: Utilizar logs e métricas para análise de problemas e realizar testes pós-lançamento para garantir estabilidade em produção.
  • Evolução da Automação: Participar ativamente da expansão da automação em E2E, Frontend e Backend.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em BDD (implementação, manutenção e utilização prática).
  • Experiência com automação de testes Web e Mobile , incluindo cenários E2E .
  • Domínio de pelo menos um framework de automação e familiaridade com outros dois.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos, preferencialmente Jira .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs para análise e rastreamento de erros.
  • Boa lógica de programação para desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts.
  • Experiência com Python .

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .


In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.


Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.


Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.


Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

title: Head of Charging
description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the role


As the Head of Charging Operations, you will be the executive leader responsible for defining and executing the strategy for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo's battery-swapping network which is the heart of our customer experience.


Reporting directly to the Founders, you will build and lead the organization that ensures not only the expansion of our charging network, but also its 24/7 operation. You will be the ultimate owner of this network efficiency and quality, managing the LiveOps, Field Operations, and Commercial Charging Teams, being responsible for preparing the area for 10x growth. This is a mission-critical leadership role that demands strategic vision, the ability to build high-performance teams, and a deep sense of ownership.


What You'll Do

  • Define the end-to-end Charging Ops strategy, including the detailed strategic plan and OKRs. Own the design of processes, systems, and team architecture required to scale the operation by 10x, improve efficiency, and increase customer satisfaction.
  • Own the area's full budget and P&L, managing and optimizing costs to meet company goals.
  • Define and monitor the area's core OKRs and KPIs.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams across LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure. Define the area's vision and culture, focusing on urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem-solving.
  • Serve as the ultimate owner of network uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Own the end-to-end energy strategy to reduce cost per kWh, including managing procurement, exploring free market (Mercado Livre) opportunities, and implementing efficiency initiatives.
  • Lead the commercial and expansion strategy for the network, defining site selection criteria to secure prime locations and network balance, negotiating strategic partnerships, and overseeing installation/launch playbooks.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the strategic voice of operations for the Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback and guiding the hardware/software roadmap to improve operability.
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, conduct post-mortems, and implement structural changes to prevent recurrence.


What We're Looking For

  • 8-12 years professional experience
  • Excellent knowledge of Brazil and Latin American business practices
  • Track record of scoping, building, training and leading large multidisciplinary teams
  • Proven expertise in process design, optimization, and creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for large-scale operation
  • An analytical and strategic mindset, with strong data-driven decision-making skills and experience defining OKRs
  • Executive communication and influencing skills, capable of aligning tech, executive, and field teams.
  • Excels in planning and executing initiatives of varying durations and scales while effectively managing stakeholders.
  • Fosters collaborative and respectful work environments
  • Technical Curiosity, a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data truly work and how to optimize them.
  • Experience in high-growth (hyper-growth) startups
  • Experience managing 24/7 systems.
  • Experience setting and leading priorities, objectives and strategic direction for entire orgs
  • Experience in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications is a plus.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Strong alignment with the company’s values


Benefits

  • A leadership role at fast-growing startup changing the face of mobility in Latin America, backed by some of the best venture capitalists in the world
  • Working at a mission driven company - we are reducing carbon emissions across the world and putting more money into the pocket of disenfranchised populations
  • Being surrounded by a talented and ambitious team that wants to build something big 
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you dare, allowing you to develop quickly
  • Competitive salary package
  • Opportunity to own a piece of the company - equity package
  • Health Insurance

﻿

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business.

title: Domain Architect Host and Cloud
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Domain Architect Host and Cloud, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .


In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Host and Cloud is responsible for structuring, governing, and accelerating the integration of on-premises infrastructures, data centers, and cloud environments of Brasil and Canada's operations. Its role is to ensure robustness, resilience, security, and scalability in sustaining the main systems, supporting digitalization, automation, energy optimization, ESG, and industrial innovation projects.

He will work directly on critical migration, modernization and platform integration projects, leading best practices in cloud computing, edge/fog, hybrid architecture, infrastructure automation, regulatory compliance and performance. This professional will have a strategic role with the global IT, technical operations, security, and business teams, sustaining and transforming multi-site and multicultural technological environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve host (mainframe, midrange, industrial servers) and cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP, Oracle Cloud) infrastructure architecture standards, aligned with global demands and multi-cloud/hybrid strategies.
  • Lead digital transformation projects, including migration of on-premises loads to the cloud, integration of critical infrastructures, automation, containerization, DevOps and continuous improvement of environments.
  • Orchestrate the implementation of solutions oriented to resilience, cybersecurity, scalability, disaster recovery, advanced backup and cost optimization.
  • Ensure adherence to international security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) and best practices in data governance and operations.
  • Support the design and implementation of robust network, storage, virtualization, automation, edge/fog topologies in complex and distributed environments.
  • Develop and maintain advanced technical documentation: diagrams, manuals, processes, automation templates, observability policies, and operational standards.
  • Follow trends and innovation in cloud, edge, intelligent infrastructure, green IT and automation, evaluating adoption opportunities in operations.
  • Direct interface with Operations, Engineering, DevOps, Security, Business and global architecture teams.
  • Produce complete documentation, guides, contingency plans, training, and best practices for support and operation teams.
  • Participate in forums, workshops, and innovation projects to keep the technological environment in line with global trends.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum experience of 8 years in technological infrastructure architecture, with relevant performance in complex multi-cloud environments, critical data centers and automation.
  • Mastery of architecture, automation and management of hybrid environments (on-prem, cloud, colocation, edge/fog) at corporate scale, with hands-on experience in Azure, AWS, GCP.
  • Solid track record in network governance, storage, virtualization, backup, industrial topologies, data protection and technological integration of critical environments (OT/IT).
  • Real experience in projects to migrate systems, workloads or data centers to the cloud, with planning, execution and monitoring of results.
  • Excellence in infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, ARM, CloudFormation), observability, cycled and advanced monitoring.
  • Practice with compliance and security: zero-trust, IAM, encryption, vulnerability management, disaster recovery.
  • Fluent English (essential), advanced Portuguese/Spanish desirable for Brazil-Canada integration.


Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence and ability to build consensus across areas, countries and cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical capacity to design efficient, secure and business-aligned solutions.
  • Clear and efficient communication with stakeholders, from technical leadership to global executive levels.
  • Proactivity, autonomy and adaptability for dynamic and multicultural environments.
  • Focus on value delivery, continuous improvement and innovation.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certification: Azure/AWS/GCP Architect, VMware, Cisco, LPIC, TOGAF, ITIL Expert.
  • Experience with OT/IT integration (industrial environments, mining, remote automation), edge/fog.
  • Experience with architectures for sustainability: Green IT, energy saving, resource optimization.
  • Previous experience in mainframe/midrange modernization projects, containerization, SRE/metrics.
  • Participation in global forums, technical communities, presentations, publications.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Detailed reference architecture for host and cloud environments, including integration, automation, observability, and resiliency solutions.
  • Execution of strategic migration and modernization projects with a focus on performance, innovation, compliance and operational excellence.
  • Support for the adoption of global standards of governance, security and cost/efficiency optimization in the Brazil and Canada environments.
  • Dissemination of good practices, technical mentoring for internal teams and continuous training.
  • Acting as an innovation agent, aligning technological evolution with sustainability, security, scalability and business results.



Additional Comments:

This role is central to the digital transformation, sustainability, automation and integration of critical environments between Brazil and Canada. It requires strategic, technical and multicultural action, with protagonism in complex environments, willingness to innovate and a strong sense of global partnership.

title: Especialista Suprimentos - Matéria Prima
description:
Sobre a vaga


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.


Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.


Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência


Sobre o papel

Realizar a gestão estratégica e operacional do suprimento de matéria-prima principal (produtos químicos primários, embalagem etc.), desde a identificação das necessidades de compra, desenvolvimento e gestão de fornecedores, negociação de contratos, acompanhamento da logística e da qualidade da matéria-prima, até a otimização de custos e a garantia do abastecimento contínuo e eficiente para a produção.



Atividades principais :

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de suprimentos de matéria-prima alinhadas com a produção e financeiros da empresa, considerando demanda, preços de mercado, disponibilidade e riscos;
  • Identificar, qualificar, desenvolver e gerenciar um portfólio de fornecedores de matéria-prima;
  • Liderar o processo de negociação de contratos de fornecimento de matéria-prima;
  • Monitorar e analisar o mercado de matéria-prima (preços, tendências, regulamentações, riscos) ;
  • Estabelecer e monitorar os padrões de qualidade da matéria-prima recebida;
  • Planejar e coordenar a logística de transporte da matéria-prima, otimizando rotas, custos e prazos de entrega, garantindo o fluxo contínuo para a fábrica;
  • Gestão de Custos: Buscar continuamente a otimização dos custos de aquisição da matéria-prima;
  • Gestão de Riscos: Identificar, avaliar e mitigar os riscos associados ao suprimento de matéria-prima;
  • Gestão de Contratos e Pedidos: Administrar os contratos de fornecimento e os pedidos de compra;
  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho dos fornecedores de matéria-prima, utilizando indicadores-chave (KPIs);
  • Colaborar estreitamente com as áreas de produção, planejamento, qualidade, financeiro e jurídico;
  • Garantir que os processos de suprimentos estejam conforme as políticas internas, as regulamentações ambientais e de sustentabilidade aplicáveis ao setor de celulose;
  • Buscar e avaliar continuamente novas fontes de suprimento de matéria-prima;
  • Criar e analisar indicadores que facilitem a administração das demandas de matéria-prima, tais como níveis de estoque, fluxo contínuo de abastecimento, Saving, Lead Time, acompanhamento da demanda, Prazo de Entregas, Devoluções;
  • Desenvolver, propor e buscar aprovação de estratégias de otimização dos custos das compras;
  • Apoiar a gerência na administração dos custos, atuando na previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend);
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias, participar e apoiar projetos, inovação, modificações e modernização de sistemas e processos relacionados a área de Suprimentos;
  • Elaborar e propor de planos de contingência para as compras de matéria-prima.


Qualificações :

  • Necessário formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;

  • Excel avançado;
  • Power Point avançado;

  • Matemática financeira com foco em formação de custos, dinâmicas de fluxo de caixa e viabilidade de investimentos.


Habilidades Preferenciais

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary

Do you want to join a team passionate about engineering data solutions to inform business decisions and transform business performance? ADM is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer, someone who thrives in an environment continuously integrating and deploying data products and analytics driving business value. The Sr. Data Engineer is responsible for delivery, adherence to standards, and mentoring team members. The Sr. Data Engineer collaborates with teams to ensure delivery and contributes to technical design and process improvements. The Sr. Data Engineer is a team player who sees problems as challenges to be creatively solved in collaboration with other data engineers, data scientists, and business colleagues. The ideal candidate is a driven learner who develops and sharpens skills building data pipelines, transforming raw data into useful data systems, and optimizing the data delivery architecture.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Responsible to design, build, refactor, and maintain data pipelines using Microsoft Azure, SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Python, and PySpark to meet business requirements for reporting, analysis, and data science
  2. Responsible to teach, adhere to, and contribute to DataOps and MLOps standards and best practices to accelerate and continuously improve data system performance
  3. Responsible to design, and integrate fault tolerance and enhancements into data pipelines to improve quality and performance
  4. Responsible to lead and perform root cause analysis and solve problems using analytical and technical skills to optimize data delivery and reduce costs
  5. Engages business end users and shares responsibility leading a delivery team.
  6. Responsible to mentor Data Engineers at all levels of experience


Job Requirements

  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Azure, SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Python, PySpark, SAP Datasphere, Power BI or other cloud-based data systems
  • Advanced experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD
  • Advanced experience with database storage systems such as cloud, relational, mainframe, data lake, and data warehouse
  • Advanced experience building cloud ETL pipelines using code or ETL platforms utilizing database connections, APIs, or file-based
  • Advanced experience with data warehousing concepts and agile methodology
  • Advanced experience designing and coding data manipulations applying processing techniques to extract value from large, disconnected datasets
  • Experienced presenting conceptual and technical improvements to influence decisions
  • Continuous learning to upskill data engineering techniques and business acumen

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology or equivalent combination of data engineering professional experience and education.
  • 7+ years proven Data Engineering experience in a complex agile environment

  • Experiência com calibração de equipamentos médicos, principalmente medidores de pressão e sistemas de Holter.

title: Regional Operations Expert

title: Consultor de Vendas - Loja Física São Paulo
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)


Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.


O Perfil que Buscamos:


Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada cliente como uma oportunidade única de encantamento. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia na loja, buscando atingir suas metas, e a criatividade para criar experiências memoráveis para o consumidor, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.


Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa o perfil do cliente para fundamentar decisões criativas na venda.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo da loja (metas, estoque, cliente) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente sobre novos rótulos e se reinventa conforme o fluxo de clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades do cliente e propõe soluções (harmonizações, presentes).
  • Resiliência: Transforma um "não" ou um desafio (um cliente que não sabe o que quer) em uma oportunidade de fidelização.


Descrição do Cargo:


O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas é a pessoa fundamental para conectar nosso portfólio de vinhos ao cliente final. Ele(a) é a "cara" da Zahil na loja, responsável por traduzir a complexidade e a história de cada garrafa em uma linguagem acessível e encantadora. É preciso ter agilidade para entender o que o cliente busca (muitas vezes, sem ele saber dizer), flexibilidade para navegar entre diferentes perfis de consumidores e uma vontade de aprender constantemente. Sua função é transformar o atendimento consultivo em resultados de vendas, fidelizando clientes e garantindo o bom funcionamento da loja.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prestar atendimento consultivo de excelência, identificando o perfil de gosto, ocasião e orçamento de cada cliente.
  • Analisar o perfil do cliente e apresentar os vinhos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença na sua experiência.
  • Apoiar ativamente na prospecção de novos clientes na loja, assim como realizar "follow up" e pós-venda para clientes cadastrados.
  • Acompanhar as metas de vendas individuais e da loja (resultados, positivações) e propor ações para atingi-las.
  • Organizar e acompanhar degustações, "mini feiras" e eventos na loja, analisando o retorno de cada ação.
  • Garantir a organização do salão de vendas, incluindo reposição de produtos, precificação e Visual Merchandising.
  • Manter-se informado sobre todas as comunicações da Zahil, chegada de produtos, mudanças de preços, promoções e novas tabelas de trabalho.
  • Transmitir à gerência da loja as dificuldades, demandas dos clientes ou oportunidades de melhoria percebidas no dia a dia.
  • Apoiar no uso do sistema interno de faturamento da loja, CRM e no cadastro de clientes.


Qualificações e Experiência


  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa ou curso técnico.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos (técnico ou de extensão) é um forte diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês e/ou espanhol (para atendimento a clientes estrangeiros).
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de dois anos em atendimento ao cliente e vendas(varejo).
  • Desejável: Experiência prévia no setor de vinhos (lojas, empórios, restaurantes).


Remuneração:

  • Regime CLT: R$ 3.000,00 (três mil reais) de salário fixo + comissão mensal

title: Especialista fiscal
description:
Nós da Odoo acreditamos que softwares para gerenciar negócios devem cobrir necessidades complexas sem serem complicados. Somos um conjunto de aplicativos de negócios em código aberto que cobre todas as necessidades das pequenas e médias empresas: CRM, e-commerce, contabilidade, estoque… Ajudamos empresas a se tornarem mais eficientes, gastando menos!

São responsáveis por garantir o sucesso da Localização Brasileira no nosso software, implementando seus módulos e atuando em contato direto com os clientes para assegurar a conformidade com as legislações fiscais e tributárias.


Para isso, você será a linha de frente, analisando as necessidades dos clientes, projetando a solução, configurando os fluxos fiscais, e fornecendo sessões de treinamento . Sua atuação é crucial para garantir que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo e do orçamento, além de ser um ponto importante de apoio para o time de P.O. de Localização Brasileira.

Basicamente, você será responsável por fornecer a melhor solução de gerenciamento fiscal/contábil aos seus clientes, prestando suporte interno com as demandas fiscais e tributárias necessárias para facilitar os negócios dos nossos clientes, apoiando PMEs de diversos setores a extrair o máximo valor da Odoo. Atuamos com foco no usuário, de maneira ágil, dinâmica e sempre pensando no longo prazo.

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes durante a implementação do Odoo.

title: Controller Sika Brazil
description:
Company Description
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation sector toward greater environmental compatibility. With more than 34,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.76 billion in 2024.
Job Description
The role is responsible for overseeing financial planning, organization, and management, ensuring the accurate recording and preparation of financial statements. It includes monitoring and controlling all economic transactions to guarantee proper administration of the company’s resources, while ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation, Sika Group policies, and best practices in financial management. Additionally, the position applies advanced techniques, tools, and operational procedures to drive efficiency and effectiveness across all financial processes.
Specific Tasks
  • Define the financial policy to be followed by the Company, in consultation and agreement with superiors.
  • Budget cash flow and determine critical moments.
  • Ensure and supervise the generation of reports to General Management and the corporate channel (Regional and Headquarters).
  • Arrange for internal audits, periodic inventory counts, etc.
  • Supervise the calculation process of standard costs for the Company's various products.
  • Control compliance with tax and labor obligations.
  • Advise General Management on matters within their professional scope.
  • Train, promote, and motivate their staff.
  • Identify needs and develop the training plan for their area, submitting it to the HR Department.
  • Know, comply with, and help disseminate the policies of the Integrated Management System, regarding Quality Management, Occupational Health and Safety, and Responsible Environmental Care of the Company.
Qualifications
Educational and Attitudinal Competencies
  • Formal education: Degree in Administration, Economics, or Public Accounting. Preferably with postgraduate training in Administration or equivalent.
  • MBA, specialized in finance, or other postgraduate studies relevant to the role.
  • Special courses: Proficiency in PC and operating systems. Financial updates. Knowledge of ISO 9001 and 14001 standards. Knowledge of accounting standards (GAAP).
  • Advanced English
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years in similar positions in medium or large companies.
  • Strong critical, reflective, and analytical capacity.
  • High level of concentration, speed, and accuracy in mathematical calculations.
  • Quick and confident decision-making.
  • Good interpersonal skills. Firm and responsible character.
  • Willingness to travel nationally and internationally on a regular basis.

title: ANALISTA DE CONTROLADORIA
description:
A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.


Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.


Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.


Como será seu dia a dia:

Você fará parte do time de Controladoria, atuando em parceria com os analistas seniores da área. No dia a dia, será responsável por apoiar na elaboração e análise dos demonstrativos financeiros, como Balanço Patrimonial, DRE e Fluxo de Caixa, além de extrair e consolidar dados contábeis para suporte às entregas do time.

Também participará do acompanhamento de auditorias, auxiliando na organização dos materiais solicitados, e contribuirá na preparação de relatórios gerenciais e internos, em interface com o time de Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A).

Além disso, dará suporte nos processos orçamentários colaborando na coleta e análise das informações que embasam as decisões financeiras da companhia.


O ambiente é colaborativo e voltado ao aprendizado contínuo, ideal para quem busca desenvolver carreira na área financeira e de controladoria.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Elaboração e análise de relatórios gerenciais

- Controle orçamentário e planejamento financeiro

- Análise de custos e auditoria interna

- Utilização avançada de Excel e SAP

- Conhecimento em normas contábeis e governança corporativa

- Trabalho em equipe e liderança de projetos

- Comunicação com outras áreas da empresa


Requisitos e qualificações

- Graduação em Ciências Contábeis

- Pós-Graduação em Controladoria

- Certificação CPA

- Experiência em análise de dados e controle orçamentário

- Conhecimento avançado em Excel e SAP

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe

- Proatividade e organização

- Conhecimento em normas contábeis e governança corporativa


Informações adicionais

Modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x na semana presenciais)

Temos alguns escritórios espalhados pelo Brasil, mas você ficará alocado na Paulista.


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

title: Especialista em Tecnologia da Informação
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Desafio


Garantir que a área de Tecnologia da Informação seja um diferencial estratégico para a operação de Celulose, promovendo inovação, eficiência, segurança e integração dos processos.


Atividades principais


  • Gerenciar projetos de inovação, digitalização e automação de processos industriais.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, orientando equipes locais e globais, promovendo boas práticas e disseminando conhecimento.
  • Garantir a conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, proteção de dados e compliance.
  • Administrar contratos, custos e orçamentos da área de TI.
  • Realizar a gestão de softwares, licenças e integrações entre sistemas corporativos (SAP, Senior, BI, Portais, etc.).
  • Propor soluções de BI, analytics, bots, powerapps e outras tecnologias para otimizar a produção, gestão de recursos e tomada de decisão.
  • Desenvolver e validar planos de contingência, assegurando a disponibilidade dos sistemas críticos.


Qualificações requeridas


Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas

Desejável Especialização Tecnologia da Informação, Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Empresarial, Indústria 4.0, Produção de Celulose

Processos de produção de celulose e vivência em indústria de celulose

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
About the job


1. About Us


We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.


2. Responsibilities


  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.

  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements


  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.


4. Job Highlights


Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Law Enforcement Specialist
description:
About Us


Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage. Our story began in 2023 in Hong Kong, China, where we became an industry leader in under a year. Building on that momentum, we entered Saudi Arabia in 2024 and soon expanded to over 20 cities. This year, we accelerated further, launching in Qatar, Kuwait, and the UAE within a remarkable 40-day span. Now, we've just launched in Brazil, through a pilot in Santos and São Vicente, with more destinations ahead.


What You'll Do


The Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT) works at the intersection of technology, public safety, and data privacy. Our mission is to support legitimate investigations by providing accurate, secure, and timely responses to requests from law enforcement and judicial authorities. We collaborate closely with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Operations teams to ensure compliance, transparency, and user data protection across all mobility platforms.


Key Responsabilities


  • Review, analyze, and respond to data requests from law enforcement, judicial, and regulatory authorities in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
  • Ensure all disclosures are lawful, properly authorized, and aligned with privacy and data protection standards.
  • Support internal investigations related to security incidents, fraud, and misuse of the platform.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails of all requests and responses.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Privacy, Security, Operations, PR) in managing high-sensitivity cases.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal workflows and contribute to process automation and operational excellence.
  • Assist in developing and delivering training sessions related to law enforcement cooperation and incident management best practices.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, International Relations, Public Administration, Information Security, or a related field.
  • Previous experience working in law enforcement response, compliance, investigations, or similar roles in technology, telecommunications, finance, or mobility sectors.
  • Strong understanding of data protection laws (LGPD or GDPR) and law enforcement data request procedures.
  • Excellent attention to detail, ability to work under pressure, and strong decision-making skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.


Nice to Have


  • Experience using case management tools (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Jira).
  • Experience with process automation or data analysis for workflow improvement.
  • Knowledge of digital law, criminal law, or regulatory frameworks.

description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Missão do cargo:

Ser responsável por conduzir e qualificar processos de performance, feedback e PDI, traduzindo dados em indicadores estratégicos que orientem decisões da alta liderança. Apoiar gestores e diretoria como parceiro de confiança, conectando iniciativas de desenvolvimento, diversidade e engajamento à estratégia corporativa, com maturidade, visão crítica e autonomia para sustentar a transformação cultural da organização.

  • PDI ( Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) - acompanhamento dos resultados individual e em grupo, com mapeamento de ações e demandas de desenvolvimento e reconhecimento;
  • Mapa de Sucessão com nível de prontidão, com estruturação de agendas de retenção talentos e para as posições chaves;
  • Apoiar e conduzir localmente as ações de desenvolvimento dos programas corporativos: Mentoria, coaching executivo, ações internacionais, etc.;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento de times, como teambuilding, dinâmicas de grupos, etc.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Grau de instrução mínimo: Ensino Superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos e/ou áreas correlatas; Pós-graduação em andamento ou completo;
  • CNH B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagem;
  • Conhecimento em Excel e Powerpoint, diferencial Power BI e/ou painel de indicadores;


Desejável: Ter atuado com SAP - módulo SuccessFactors.

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
About the job


1. About Us


We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.


2. Responsibilities


  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements


  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.


4. Job Highlights


Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:

Se você busca desafios reais, autonomia e a chance de criar produtos que impactam milhares de pessoas, essa vaga é para você!


Atividades e Responsabilidades

Apoio técnico ao Product Manager, essencial execução de demandas de codificação e resolução de bloqueios junto ao time de desenvolvimento.


Principais Responsabilidades:
